balls.text: and Steyn provides a brilliant finishing touch. Fuller than a length ball, but not near a yorker by a long way. Steyn has driven this through extra cover for four. This is some batting

another length ball. Steyn is giving himself runs to bowl at. This over should be shown to budding bowlers. "What Not To Bowl At Death". He has absolutely clobbered it well over long-on, into the stands
driven wide of long-on. Steyn calls for two right away. Comes back easily
slower ball gone horribly wrong. Well wide outside off
another length ball. This could have gone for six. Steyn misses on the heave. That head fell away while he attempted it
filthy length ball. Why can't they attempt yorkers in the last overs? Steyn clears the front leg, and smashes this straight of long-on for four
full and straight, beats his shot, hits him on the pads

He is given. Five-wicket haul for Faulkner, the first of this IPL. And the big wicket of Sammy too. Length ball, middle and leg, straightens a little. Sammy is playing across the line, is beaten on the inside edge. Looks out
slower ball, but a half-volley outside off, driven to long-off for one
lovely yorker. Dug out for just a single
slower ball, but it is a length ball outside off, and Sammy has swiped this between long-on and deep midwicket.
full toss, on the pads, he mis-hits this one, but has placed it wide of long-on, and comes back for the second
driven to extra cover for one

first twenty20 fifty for Sammy. He walks down the wicket to guide this length ball to the left of the short fine leg. And immediately starts sucking on that baby thing he is wearing in his neck. I don't know what they call it. The background: he has just had a baby girl. "Princess Skai," he calls her

Reddy sees a length ball, wants to smack it out of the ground, but the ball is just a bit shorter than he expects, and he ends up skying it towards long-on. Rahane takes a smart catch there, keeping his eyes on this skier all the way
full toss, on the pads, but they have a deep midwicket in place, who keeps this shot down to one
driven hard to deep cover where Sachin fumbles to allows them the second
pushed into the leg side for one
another drop. Full ball, hit straight back at his waist high, but yet another Karnataka fielder lets one go. They take two off the ricochet
full, middle and leg, driven to long-on
driven down to long-off for one
dropped by Dravid at extra cover. Poor fielding. Doesn't even make a proper effort. Just stiks out one hand hesitantly
short of a length, on off, punched away to cover
short, slow, wide, and he has cut this away for four. Poor bowling at that pace
full, middle and leg, bunted into the leg side. All fielders in the deep so they get a couple
seams away from short of a length, beats Sammy as he looks to run it down
slower ball, but this time Sammy has picked it early, and waits for it to arrive. Drives it wide of long-off for four. Sammy's highest score in T20s
walks down the wicket to drive this to long-off for one
slower ball, Sammy can;t play the big shot, gets a single to cover
wide length ball, Sammy drives at it, and is beaten by the outswing
another leave outside off. This one seams away a touch from the line of off
wide length ball, gets away with it, as Sammy can't reach it
no room on this, defended to cover
short of a length, outside off, steered away to the right of third man for a couple
slower ball, short of a length, on off, Sammy moves back and across and works this to leg for a single
full, down the leg side, clipped away to the right of deep square leg for a couple
full and straight, kept out, but doesn't get a single

and he takes a wicket as soon as he comes back. Mishra has thrown it away. He goes hard at a length ball wide outside off, and ends up slicing it in the air. Sammy will hate it if he left stranded. This was the back-of-thehand slower ball
short of a length, into the pads, flicked away for a single
slower ball, 105ks, Sammy goes ahead with the shot this time, and good thing for him he has not timed it. Falls short of long-off
short of a length, outside off, pushed to the right of point for one
Mishra backs away and tries a wild hit. Beaten
defended back to Binny as this is pitched short of a length, and on off
short of a length, outside off, punched down to long-off for one
slower ball again, bunted into the leg side, he wants two but IPL debutant Sachin  Baby is quick to charge in from deep midwicket. He keeps them down to one
first six of the day. Trivedi has bowled many slower balls, but the moment he bowls his gentle regulation pace, for a thigh-high short ball, Sammy pulls it over square leg for six
slower balls are working against Sammy because his back lift is huge. Aborted again in favour of a defensive shot
short, outside off, 128ks, pulled away with ease to deep midwicket
walks down to counter the slower ball, but Trivedi bowls short. Sammy fends in front of his chest, gets a single to leg
slower ball, just outside off, Sammy aborts the big back lift and defends it back
short of a length, outside off, seams away to beat the outside edge
another wide. No. 7 in this innings. Outside off
length ball, on the pads, flicked to short fine leg
driven to long-off for one
short of a length, hits the outside half of the bat, and they take two
drives at this one, but is early into the shot, and has to check it. Defended to cover
wide length ball, Sammy shapes up to drive, but leaves it alone
slower ball, bounces at him, hits the high part of the bat, but they take a single to cover
short, middle and leg, pulled away to long leg for one
Mishra shows him an early backing-away movement, and then stands his ground to loft a length ball back over the bowler's head
short of a length again, on the stumps, bunted into the leg side, and they steal the second as all the fielders on the leg side are deep
short of a length, outside off, Rahane makes a diving save at point
short of a length, outside off, pushed to point
Sammy keeps getting them the runs. Short, down the leg side, with fine leg up. Even the top edge clears him and goes for four
driven to long-on for one
driven to long-off for one
full, middle and leg, pushed wide of mid-on
short of a length, outside off, looks to run it fine. Is beaten. Good job he didn't succeed at the shot. There is a slip in place
full toss, but dug out straight to mid-off
that's just a push. But what a push. High back lift to meet this length ball outside off, but no follow-through. Driven through cover for four
short of a length, on off, pushed towards long-on for a single
slower ball, short of a length, on off, hits the outside edge. Goes to point
another wide, but I thought I heard some thing. Down the leg side, Mishra is not playing at it, but I thought it hit the thigh pad. No replays
this one seams in a little, Mishra defends off the back foot
the wide slip. Not sure about that field placement. This one seams away a little, gets the edge, but has gone where the regulation slip would have been
down the leg side, another wide. Five wides so far
short of a length, angling in, beats Mishra who is charging at it
short of a length, on the pads, concedes leg-byes
Mishra charges at him, drives hard, gets a single to third man
too full, too straight, glanced down the leg side, fine of fine leg
pitched up, the sucker delivery, Mishra beaten on the drive by the outswing
bouncer, on the stumps, Mishra ducks under it
another edge, but this falls short of Hodge at wide slip. Sammy slips while turning for the second
short, wide, cut away to deep cover for one
winds up for another big hit, but decides late to let it be
lovely shot. On a length, outside off, driven on the up, over extra cover
short, wide, beaten on the cut. Called wide
length ball, slanted down leg, concedes a leg-bye. Given run, though. Could have been an inside edge
nearly an off-side wide, but not quite. Left alone
Cooper is trying hard to prove he didn't get lucky with Vihari's wicket, and that he had planned it. Not working, though. Well down the leg side
another wide down the leg side, and this time he lets it be a bye
and even he strikes first ball. Strangled down the leg side. A gentle loosener down the leg side, and he has gloved it through. No thigh pad in the vicinity, it had to have come off the glove
length ball, middle and leg, driven between mid-on and midwicket for four. All along the ground
short of a length, cutting in, hits him on the thigh pad
full, half-volley, on the pads, and he has punched this down the ground for four. No follow-through at all. Typical Sammy shot
wide down the leg side
pushed to mid-on, and gets off the strike
the offcutter this time. He is just hitting the seam just short of a length, just outside off. This has cut him in two
where was he in the Tests? This is an unplayable legcutter. Short of a length, on off, cuts away after pitching. How has he not edged it?
another forward-defensive from Sammy
full, outside off, pushed to mid-off
the sun is going down fast on Sunrisers. Perera slogs again, and finds long-on this time
slower, dipping a bit, defended to cover
slogged away. Not a pretty sight, but effective. He has lashed at this with one hand, and through midwicket to beat the man in the deep
on a length, on off, defended back to him
slower ball, 110ks, short of a length, just outside off, defended off the back foot
short ball again, rising towards the chest again, fended in hope
and another one pulls the blinds on the Sunrisers. Short, gets a bit big, rises towards the chest, and takes the top edge on the pull. Hodge runs in from fine leg to claim this skier
slower-ball yorker, 111ks, middle and leg, dug out by him
bouncer from Faulkner, Sharma sways out of its line
short of a length, outside off, dabbed away to third man for one
nice shot. He has timed it superbly. On a length, into the pads, flicked between the bowler and mid-on for four
on a length, outside off, defended back to him
short of a length now, can't drive at it, and hence plays the defensive
pitched up outside off, chipped over cover for a couple
short of a length, on off, defended back to him
length ball, turning in, pushed to long-on for one

It's all too dark for Sunrisers here. This is quite a bonus for Rajasthan Royals. Short, wide, four written all over it, but Dhawan pulls out his eraser and rewrites "out" all over it. Cuts this straight and low to backward point, and Rahane is sharp there
short, widish, steered away to third man for one

Watson is taking all the catches. Another poor shot from Sunrisers. Wide length ball, Sanga throws his bat at it without moving his feet. He is playing well away from his body, and the ball seams away to take a healthy edge. Watson takes a sharp overhead catch at first slip
short of a length, outside off, 134ks, left alone
driven on the up, but straight to cover
and he sends down a gift to Sanga first ball. Short, wide, asking to be hit, and he has smashed this in front of square for four
on a length, just outside off, defended to cover

Chandila strikes. Quite a poor stroke from Reddy. Chandila has been slow through the air, and Reddy is beaten the flight as he charges at him. Reddy ends up hoicking, but gets a massive leading edge. Off you go
down the wicket again, not quite to the pitch of the ball, finds cover
short, pulled away, there is a deep midwicket in place, and they run the second on the fumble. Binny is the culprit
tossed up, slow, dipping on him. Reddy is down the wicket to drive it, but back to him
drives at the first ball, back to Chandila, who fields well

Watson gets the short ball, he can hit this for a six, but this is not that short, and he doesn't get all on the pull. He has placed this to the left of Steyn at deep midwicket, though. Steyn goes flying again, but can;t prevent the four
short again, pulled to the right of deep midwicket for four. Steyn makes another desperate effort in vain

Steyn makes a desperate effort at deep midwicket, but can't hold on. Don't bowl short to Watson. He pulls it, Steyn goes flying at deep midwicket, gets a hand to this, but it still lands on the rope. Steyn signals a six
short of a length, on off, punched to long-on for one
shortish, pulled to long-on for one
driven on the up, but straight to mid-off. Steyn has bowled out now
short and wide, cut away powerfully, but finds deep cover
short of a length, gets a bit big on him, hits him on the thigh pad
short now, Bin y ramps it over slip, but the third man is fine enough to keep them down to one
edged towards slip again, this bounces short of Sammy, but he has his body right behind the ball
no edge is going to hand. Begins with an outswinger, gets an edge, and even though there is a wide slip in place, this one goes wider
full and wide, and this one is deliberate. Smartly played. Comes down on it with an open face, and guides it wide of Sanga and fine of third man
slower ball, but a wide length ball, and Watson does well to go over cover and not straight down the ground. This mis-hit finds the gap, and gets them four more
length ball. Watson imagines another six. Drives hard at this, but is beaten by the away movement
he has murdered this for a parallel six. Perera doesn't have the pace to be bowling in his own half. He takes this from outside off, and clobbers it over midwicket
steered away to third man for a single. Over to Watson
Perera bowls a ripper. This one kicks away from short of a length, and rises chest high to beat his fend

evades the flying Dhawan at long-on. Is this the over that has changed the match, and as it too often happens in this format, based purely on luck? Watson pulls, mis-hits, and sends it down the ground. Looks like Dhawan will catch it at long-on. He sets himself up for it, at the edge of the field, but it clears him
nicely played. Quick hands. Short, stays low, but Watson is quick to swivel and pull it through square leg for four. On the pads too. First bad ball of the over, and he has gone for 14 already
short of a length, outside off, steered away to third man for one
short of a length, on off, guided to third man for one

through the first slip again. Watson might want to finish the game and go to a casino with pads still on. Yorker on off, he tries to dig it out with a straight face, but it hits the edge and goes through first slip for four more. Unlucky Ishant

and Watson gets one through first slip again. Watson has ridden his luck, and brings up his fifty. Short of a length, not short enough to cut, but he goes hard at it, and the edge flies. No chance for Sanga
short of a length, seaming in, defended to short midwicket
pushed to straightish midwicket where Ashish Reddy fumbles. A clean pick-up and throw would have made this interesting
short of a length, no room, defended

Vihari takes the risk at deep cover. That's good on him. Watson is done in by the slower ball and mis-hits it towards deep cover where Vihari wants to the catch, forget saving the four. Doesn't quite reach it, and the ball bounces over his arms for four too
short of a length, into the pads, worked away to deep square for one
slower ball, shortish, steered to third man for a single
low full toss, driven to long-on for one
the rare length ball. That should have gone really, but Dravid fails. Hit on the bottom of the bat, and he holes out to deep midwicket for a 35-ball 36
the full ball again, but a bit too straight. However, Watson can;t time this flick owing to the fullness of the ball, and short fine leg fields
full, just outside off, Dravid digs it out for one. Good comeback over from Perera so far
length ball outside off, driven powerfully, straight to long-off
low full toss. Misses the yorker by inches, but it is still effective enough. Pushed to midwicket
slower ball, moral victory for Sammy, but the mis-hit clears midwicket, and gets Dravid a couple
short of a length, wide outside off, Dravid has backed away, which is why he can;t reach this
short of a length, on off, worked into the leg side for one
slower ball, gets an edge on the cut, Sanga does well to dive to his right and get a hand to it. Saves three runs
short of a length, nicely punched away, but finds point
short of a length, on the pads, nicely clipped away past the short fine leg. Superb awareness of the field
long hop. You don't bowl that to Watson. He rocks back and sends it flying it over deep midwicket. I have seen this so many times I can call this bit of action eyes closed

hit back powerfully at Mishra. The ball bounces short of Mishra, and hits the stumps. Dravid is short, and Mishra appeals. They wait for them to run the two, and then go to the third umpire. Replays show no touch. Fair play, anybody?
down the wicket again, beaten in the flight, but hasn't hit it well enough to reach long-off
Dravid hits a six. Takes his strike rate to 100. Down the wicket, not close to the pitch of the ball, but that only gives him room to swing through, and he clears long-on
tossed up nicely, misfielded by Mishra, allows a single through his legs
shortish, hit down to long-on for one
that's the long hop that Watson is waiting for. It stays low, which is why it has been pulled for four only. First boundary in 3.2 overs. Still the asking rate is 9.2 now
cut away to the left of deep cover, and they still take just the single. Must be the heat
flighted, middle and leg, thumped to long-on for one
short, not wide, cut away straight to deep cover
slightly short, Watson wants to pull, but hits it down to long-on for one
full, on off, defended back to him off the front foot

wide of the crease again, too short, cut away in front of square to the right of deep cover, and again they take just the one. And it's not Dravid who is converting these twos to one. Both seem equally fast or slow
looks to cut, but this is not short enough. Beaten
wide of the crease, short and wide, cut away to the left of deep cover, but they take just the single. This is two in almost every T20 match
dropped into the leg side for a single
huge lbw appeal, but this one hasn't turned enough. Tossed up, very slow, on leg, beats the sweep, but only about holds its line. Had it broken back, Watson was dead
he starts off with a perfect length ball, on off, defended back to him
short, wide, gets away with it as Dravid is beaten on the cut. Dravid five runs behind a strike rate of 100
slower ball, stays low too, beats him on the cut
fuller, on off, Dravid is early into the drive, mis-hits it to cover
short of a length, seaming in a little towards middle, defended back to him
short of a length, outside off, steered to third man for one
short of a length, seaming in, clipped to leg for one
wide length ball, driven to sweeper-cover for one
dabbed away late, gets a single to third man
and that wide slip again. Why do you have a slip and not in the regulation catching position? This is a regulation edge, and would have been swallowed by the first slip
this one seams back in from short of a length, Watson is crmaped for room again, and dabs this one to slip again
short again, but just outside off, cramping him up. Watson dabs on it, but can't clear slip
gentle short ball. That's about 130ks at best, and is rising slowly towards the chest. Asking to be hit, and hit Watson does
short of a length, 137ks, stops at him, Dravid ends up jabbing at it in front of his body
short and wide, and Dravid has cut this deliberately in the air, and over point. You don't bowl short and wide to Dravid, no matter the format
short of a length, outside off, holds its line, beats Dravid, who is looking to open the face
driven on the up. Beautifully done. Rising with the shortish ball, he drives it past cover for four
open the face on a shortish delivery, past the slip, gets a single
short of a length, seams in a little. Defended in front of off
outswinger, pushed back at him from in front of off
steered away to the right of point. A fumble by Sammy there allows them the single
short of a length, into the pads, pushed away to deep midwicket
goes for the magic ball, and strays too far down the leg side for a wide
squares him up, but the edge is soft and clears second slip for a single
well played. Steyn has pitched short for the first time, and Watson is back and on his toes to use his pace and guide it past point for four
the second slip in action, but it bounces well in front of him. Was an outswinger again
short of a length, outside off, seams away and bounces too. Dravid is surprised and beaten too
pushed to cover off the front foot
short of a length, seaming in, back-cut away to third man for one
short and wide again. Poor bowling so far on a helpful pitch. Watson cuts this hard into the ground, and it bounces over point for four
seaming in, headed down leg, concedes a leg-bye
short, wide, poor. Cut away, but can;t beat cover. Perera gets away with it
fuller, starts middle and off, swings towards off. Defended from the crease. Steyn is irresistible today
short of a length, starts outside off, left alone
squared him up with a perfect outswinger headed to top of off. Defended

desperate shot. Steyn has unsettled them into playing a godawaful shot. That's the problem of T20. you need just a few dot balls. Rahane backs away and heaves. The ball shapes away and takes the toe end of the bat through to Sanga
straighter, shaping away towards off, defended off the back foot
quick outswinger, 142ks, Rahane pushes at it without any feet. Beaten as expected
clipped away off the pads. This length ball got a bit too straight, and Dravid took full toll. Through square leg for four
superb delivery. Short of a length, outside off, Dravid looks to cut, but this has seamed back a long way to cut him into two. Sanga has to make a diving take down the leg side
on a length, on off, pushed to mid-off
walks down the wicket to dab this shortish ball to third man for one
short of a length, holds its line in front of off, defended off the back foot
short of a length, on off, flicked away to long leg for one
left alone to second slip. He makes a belated decision to leave this alone, ans the ball is way too quick for him. Good thing for him, it bounces straight after hitting the bat
another good outswinger. Towards top of off. Defended off the back foot
another good outswinger, just outside off, defended to cover
this outswinger starts from middle and leg, and he defends off the back foot, in front of off
squared up again, but this time he manages to run this to third man for one
what a first ball. Uff. This should be a Test match. Outswinger at 141ks, shorot of driving length, and leaves him after pitching on off. Dravid is squared up, and beaten
